title: Birria Bomb RAMEN
description: A flavorful fusion dish combining traditional birria with ramen noodles.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Stir in garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, and black pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the beef broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Add the shredded birria beef to the broth and cook for 10 minutes to combine flavors.
Meanwhile, cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Divide the cooked noodles into bowls.
Ladle the hot broth with beef over the noodles.
Top with chopped cilantro and sliced jalapeños.
notes:
Feel free to add more jalapeños for extra spice.
